description: Free. Second step of kya_renew: send both signatures of the renewal challenge; the credential is re-issued for 90 days if the e-CNPJ is not revoked and the company is still ATIVA.

agent_signature.description: Signature of challenge.text by the agent key: EIP-191 personal_sign hex (evm) or raw Ed25519 base64url (web-bot-auth).

ecnpj_signature.description: CMS/PKCS#7 SignedData (detached, base64 DER) of challenge.text, signed with the company's e-CNPJ certificate.

name: kya_renew_prove
